cultivation_relevance: National fruit of India. Gujarat's 'Gir Kesar' (Talala Gir) and Valsad 'Alphonso' (Hapus) are globally renowned export commodities with GI registrations.

climate_and_soil.climate_type: Tropical and subtropical with distinct dry season preceding flowering
climate_and_soil.temperature_range_celsius: Optimal 24°C to 30°C; frost susceptible; high humidity/rain during flowering triggers anthracnose and powdery mildew
climate_and_soil.annual_rainfall_mm: 750 - 2500 mm; requires complete dry weather from October to March for flower bud induction
soil_types: Medium black soil with minimum 1.5 - 2.0 m depth
climate_and_soil.drainage: Deep well-drained profile; waterlogging causes root asphyxiation and sudden tree decline

seasons: Perennial tree fruit (Flowering: Dec-Feb; Harvesting: April-July)

planting_details.sowing_time: Planting of grafted epicotyl/inarching grafts: July - August during monsoon
planting_details.seed_rate: Traditional spacing: 40 trees/acre (10m x 10m); High Density Planting (HDP): 200 trees/acre (5m x 4m) or Ultra HDP (3m x 2m)
planting_details.spacing: 10 m x 10 m (standard) or 5 m x 5 m (semi-intensive)
planting_details.sowing_depth: Pits of 1m x 1m x 1m filled with FYM, SSP, and topsoil; keep graft union 15 cm above ground

critical_stages: Fruit development stage (marble to egg size - weekly watering essential for fruit sizing)
STRICT STRESS PERIOD: Withhold all irrigation from October to December to induce flower buds!
irrigation_methods: Drip irrigation (2 inline drippers per tree)
Ring basin method around canopy dripline
water_management.water_requirement_mm: Varies by tree age; mature 10+ year tree needs 80-120 L/day during fruit sizing

nutrient_management.fym_manure_per_acre: 50 kg FYM per mature tree applied in September in circular trench along canopy dripline
nutrient_management.recommended_npk_ratio: Per mature tree (10+ yrs): 1000 g N, 500 g P2O5, 1000 g K2O (Apply full P & K with half N after harvest in July; remaining half N in Sept-Oct)
biofertilizers: Paclobutrazol (Cultar) @ 3-5 ml per meter canopy diameter applied in Sept for regular flowering in alternate-bearing varieties
micronutrients: Foliar spray of Borax (0.2%) + Zinc Sulphate (0.5%) + Urea (1%) at marble stage

harvest_and_yield.maturity_days: 100 - 130 days from fruit set to harvest
harvest_and_yield.harvesting_signs: Shoulders become plump; skin colour changes from dark green to olive green; specific gravity 1.01 to 1.02; fruit picked with 1 cm stem pedicel using mango harvesters
harvest_and_yield.expected_yield_per_acre: 4 to 8 tonnes per acre for mature orchard (100-150 kg per tree)
harvest_and_yield.post_harvest_storage: Desap immediately to prevent sap burn; hot water treatment (48°C for 60 min) against fruit fly; pack in CFB boxes at 12°C

nutrient_deficiencies: Black Tip (Boron deficiency / brick kiln fumes)
